open_items: ILO flapped to provider_down at cycle 1174: HTTP 403 on every check, both paths (gateway metadata, gateway data, direct metadata, direct data, direct json). Ten contract assertions broke with observed 403. Live recheck returned an inconsistent mix of 200/403 on identical requests seconds apart; direct json consistently 200. Fifth occurrence of the recurring ILO 403 pattern (cycle 32, 1150, 1162, 1168, now 1174), this time the widest yet (every check, both paths). Watch next cycle; if 403s persist for two consecutive cycles that is new territory and would warrant escalation, since all four prior occurrences cleared within one cycle.

ESTAT flapped healthy -> gateway_issue -> healthy between cycles 1172 and 1174 (failing check at 1173: 'gateway metadata: Error:', empty body). Matches the known list_dataflows-under-load timeout pattern (last seen cycle 1170), not new. The empty error body has now recurred twice (1170, 1173) without ever carrying a fuller message; worth a closer look eventually but not urgent.
ABS encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flipped cosmetically again at cycle 1174 (same pattern previously seen on ABS/ILO/OECD); verdict stayed ok, not an incident.
STATSNZ auth:listing capability_appeared, first seen cycle 60, still present at cycle 1174. Still open, not re-reported since no new change.
112 claude/ triage branches on origin as of this run (up from 111 at cycle 1168). Still above the 20 the skill flags for pruning; not actioned by this read-only routine.
This run's own merge-to-main attempt is reported separately in the session output; if it fails, this run's findings stay recorded on this branch and the next run's branch-scan will pick them up.

Long-running architectural facts, not incidents: ILO /availableconstraint/ returns 500 (constraints come via ?references=all); ESTAT has no practical constraint support; ESTAT direct json check is skipped by design (Eurostat returns 406 for SDMx-JSON); BIS/ILO/IMF references:contentconstraint reads ignored (accepted and silently dropped); ABS/ILO/OECD encoding:structure_xml Content-Type charset/version parameter order flips cosmetically from time to time, verdict always stays ok.
